# Awesome Jev Prompts

> A curated library of question patterns, anti-patterns, and calibration notes for Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model for typed decisions (Choice / Score / Noul). Question design is the prompt engineering of typed decisions.

Facts: Jev 1.13 (`jev-latest` alias), POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, $0.042/1M input tokens (output free), 64k context (32k state + longest question), 250k tokens/sec, 1,200 req/min, text-only, Choice cardinality capped at 255. Core rule: questions describe judgments; code owns composition, thresholds, and side effects.

## Index

- [Awesome Jev Prompts (README)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/README.md): intro, primitives, quick facts, quick start, official resources
- [中文版 README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/README.zh-CN.md)
- [Choice patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/choice-patterns.md): intent routing, tool selection, model routing, best-of-N, document classification, skill routing
- [Score patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/score-patterns.md): severity rubrics, quality gates, moderation, RAG relevance, priority queues
- [Noul patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/noul-patterns.md): policy checks, duplicate detection, citation checks, human escalation, retry control
- [Routing & triage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/routing-and-triage.md): inbox triage, ticket queues, RAG filtering, document streams
- [Guardrails & verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/guardrails-and-verification.md): LLM output guardrails, jailbreak detection, structured-output validation, code review gates
- [Context compaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/context-compaction.md): keep-or-drop, summarize-or-quote, tool-result pruning
- [Anti-patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/anti-patterns.md): the ten ways Jev questions go wrong, with fixes
- [Calibration & eval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vicfei/awesome-jev-prompts/main/categories/calibration-and-eval.md): thresholds from logged distributions, versioned questions, consistency checks, shadow mode, System Two handoff

## Optional
